title: pskill
imageAlt: Headline "Agent skills as programs, not long text" above the pskill viewer, which draws the implement-issue skill as a graph of steps next to the details of one step
description: *pskill* is an **open-source tool** that runs coding-agent skills as **programs, not long text**. A skill becomes a **typed YAML graph** of steps. A small runner hands the agent one step at a time and checks each answer, so the agent cannot skip a step or lose a value.

I designed the format, the runner and the [**visual viewer**](https://triunitystudios.com/pskill/), which draws each skill as a graph and replays every run in the browser. It works in **Claude Code** and **Codex**, and installs with one command.
Skills carry their own tests, which run with no AI model, and the project holds **100% test coverage**.
